test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that changes the voice of the following sentence.

The newlywed couple has bought a new house in Delhi.

options.text: A new house in Delhi was being bought by the newlywed couple.
A new house in Delhi has been bought by the newlywed couple.
A new house in Delhi have been bought by the newlywed couple.
A new house in Delhi was bought by the newlywed couple.

solution:
The correct answer is: **'A new house in Delhi has been bought by the newlywed couple'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option is:** 'A new house in Delhi has been bought by the newlywed couple'.**
 
• The given sentence is in **'Present Perfect Tense'. It's structure is: 'Subject + Have/ Has + V3 (Third form of the verb) + Object'.**
 
• According to the rule of Active to Passive Voice, the 'Subject' in 'Active voice' becomes the 'Object' in 'Passive voice' and 'Object' in 'Active voice' becomes 'Subject' in 'Passive voice'. 
 
• The 'Subject in Passive voice is followed by Helping verb(Have/ Has ) + Been + V3 (Third form of the verb) + by + Object'.
 
• 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is: 'Option 2'.​

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​'****A new house in Delhi was being bought by the newlywed couple' **is not the correct Active to Passive.
 
• **'A new house in Delhi have been bought by the newlywed couple' **is not the correct Active to Passive.
 
• **'A new house in Delhi was bought by the newlywed couple' **is not the correct Active to Passive.
